Field Descriptions

wdogcount

31 bit wdt counter registers. On write, the counter will be set to the written value, then continue counting up. KEY reg must be written to before any other register in this addrmap can be written to, unlocking the WDT. After writing to another register, the WDT will be locked again, and KEY must be written to again to unlock it.
